title: The persistence of earnings and cash flows and the role of special items: Implications for the accrual anomaly
sources_checked: Local COMP.FUNDA at ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat (catalog: PROC CONTENTS source catalog, COMP.FUNDA lines 27500–27523); snapshot modified 2026-07-22, 941,340 metadata rows. Local CRSP.DSEDELIST at ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/crsp/a_stock/dsedelist.sas7bdat (catalog lines 81323–81760); snapshot modified 2025-12-06, 38,872 metadata rows. DLSTDT spans 1926–2024 and has 544 dated events in FY/calendar 2008; the accepted delisting code/date rule is retained.

Fresh controller build output: work/runtime/20261118T091017445707Z/build.lst reports 95,463 handoff rows, 89,355 Table 2 rows, and zero handoff formula errors; work/data/accrual_persistence_main/reg.dta metadata retains fyear as int16. Native regression logs report 2003–2007 contributions and last_added=2007.
changes: Kept the original fiscal-year start at 1988 and extended the observation end from 2002 to 2007. The existing adjacent-year construction retains FY 1987 for the lag and adds FY 2008 for the one-year earnings/equity lead.

Rebuilt one pooled historical-plus-added sample from current local COMP.FUNDA, CRSP.CCMXPF_LNKHIST, CRSP.STOCKNAMES and CRSP.DSEDELIST. Changed only the SAS source bound to FY 1987–2008 and the t-year pool bound to FY 1988–2007; retained source screens, transformations, pooled 1% trimming, annual rank procedure, event rules, and OLS terms.

Retained fyear through the SAS-to-Stata handoff and added fit-active Stata e(sample) counts by original/added period for both regression cells. The pooled trim produces 69,916 original-period observations in these fits versus 70,084 in the saved period-only predecessor run.
limitations: The accepted Attempt 02 best-effort reconstruction estimated 70,084 Table 2 observations for 1988–2002, compared with 61,989 reported in the paper. The predecessor review says the difference remains unexplained by available paper detail and provider vintage. This extended replay retains that construction; pooled trimming yields 69,916 original-period observations plus 19,439 added-period observations.

The paper leaves average-assets dates, delisting book-equity and deflator dates, the delisting code set, no-lead event window, and trimming population/order partly unspecified. The accepted code uses average assets from adjacent annual observations, the documented event-date replacement rule and DLSTCD 500 or 520–584; these inherited best-effort choices remain.

The inherited review also identifies uncertainty about the full financial-variable trimming universe and tie handling for annual bottom-decile ranks. The accepted builder keeps its declared pooled P1/P99 cutoffs and PROC RANK TIES=MEAN convention.
The Stata template reports two-sided p-values and 10%, 5%, and 1% stars; the paper’s Table 2 legend specifies 5% and 1% only.
